Final crop 3:2 with room for a title. The split is assembled from two licensed photos only (a plain brand-graphic divider is fine); never AI or a composite that invents a view. Source: the venue's own media kit or press office with written permission (Gmail draft request, never sent by an agent), or licensed premium stock bought by a human and added to library-index.csv. Never AI, never a competitor, directory, planner, photographer-blog or search-result image. Location proven by the media kit, register row or EXIF, never by appearance.
